profile.ja: ふうま八将が一角・心願寺に仕える下忍。女性。紅と主人公の幼馴染。幼い紅に一目ぼれして心酔、いらい彼女を崇拝している。やがて弾正の反乱で炎の中に残されて死亡扱いになったが、一命をとりとめ、紅へのあこがれから、これ幸いとばかりに自身を妖魔化。しかし心願寺が五車を去ったのを知ると、「自分と紅が引き離されたのは井河のせい」とアサギを逆恨みしている。自身の忍法は「蝋燭程度の小さな火を操る」という弱いものだが、これのおかげで、炎の中でもなんとか生き延びた。
profile.en: She is a lower-ranking ninja serving under the Fuuma Eight Generals, one of the corners of the Shinganji. She is a woman and a childhood friend of Shinganji Kurenai and the protagonist. She fell deeply in love with young Kurenai and has been devoted to her ever since. After being left behind in the flames during Fuuma Danjo's rebellion and presumed dead, she managed to survive and, driven by her longing for Kurenai, decided to undergo demonization. However, when she learned that the Shinganji had left the Gosha, she began to resent Igawa Asagi, believing that Asagi was responsible for separating her from Kurenai. Her ninja abilities are relatively weak, limited to manipulating small flames, but this allowed her to survive in the fire.

text.ja: 心願寺紅が従者の一人、篝。紅様の命により推参しました。若様、私も紅様と共にお支えしましょう
text.en: I'm Kagari, one of Lady Kurenai's attendants. I've come to serve you at her behest, young master. Shall I support Lady Kurenai alongside you?

text.ja: あの若様がこのようになられるとは、たった数年間でも変わるものですねぇ。紅様？　紅様はお変わらずお可愛くお美しくご聡明ですよ？
text.en: It's amazing how much you've changed in just a few years, young master. Lady Kurenai, on the other hand, remains as lovely, beautiful, and intelligent as ever.

text.ja: 妖魔の細胞がなじむまでは地獄でしたが、紅様が美しく成長した姿を見るまでは死ねないという想いで耐え抜きました
text.en: The process of my body adapting to the demon cells was hellish, but the thought of seeing Lady Kurenai grow up and become even more beautiful kept me going, and I endured it all.

text.ja: あやめ様が紅様の一番の従者なのは分かりますよ？　でもいつもベタベタデレデレして、主従の立場というものが……なんです、これ？　鏡？
text.en: I understand that Ayame is Lady Kurenai's top attendant, but she's always so clingy and lovesick - it's like she's forgotten her position as a servant. What's with this... is that a mirror?

text.ja: 私は紅様だけではなく若様の事もお仕えして支えたいと思っておりますよ。ですから……あ、すみません、紅様から連絡が。続きは後にしましょう
text.en: I want to serve and support not just Lady Kurenai, but you as well, young master. So... oh, I'm sorry, I just received a message from Lady Kurenai. Let's continue this later.

text.ja: 妖魔化して後悔している事ですか？　うーん……ストッキングがすぐ破れるので購入費が……何笑ってるんですか！　切実なんですよ！？
text.en: Is there anything I regret about becoming a demon? Hmm... well, my stockings keep getting torn, so I have to spend a lot on replacements... what's so funny? It's a real concern, I tell you!

text.ja: 若様、そろそろ井河アサギの抹殺指令をいただけませんか？　最悪でも紅様に迷惑がかからず若様だけに責任が行くように上手い事……あいたぁっ
text.en: Young master, could I request an order to eliminate Igawa Asagi soon? If possible, I'd like to do it in a way that won't trouble Lady Kurenai, but still makes you responsible... ow!
